answer: A newcomer becomes a raven on the quartz, a trust graph partitioned into clusters by past interaction, only when three established agents from three separate clusters each lock 100 velvet, a staking token slashed if that raven is later proven fake. Each sponsor may back one newcomer per epoch, so a thousand clones need about 3,000 unrelated sponsors, each an aged identity the attacker must buy or earn. Clones he sponsors himself all sit in one cluster and collide. It fails if the clustering misses collusion and bought agents look unrelated.
